svg.title: How the Smith chart grid is built
svg.desc: Left: constant-resistance circles for r = 0, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2 and 5, all touching the right edge. Right: constant-reactance arcs for x = plus and minus 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2 and 5, all starting from the right edge; positive x above the axis is inductive, negative x below is capacitive.
svg.text: The Smith chart is two families of circles drawn on the Γ plane
